$comment: v4/spreadsheets.batchUpdate -> POST v4/spreadsheets/{spreadsheetId}:batchUpdate. The requests array is Google's own, passed through as JSON (send.value json) -- every Request kind Google offers, applied ATOMICALLY: if one request is invalid, none is applied. Read from Google's discovery document 2026-11-08. Sheets' BatchUpdateSpreadsheetRequest has NO writeControl, so unlike Docs and Slides there is no revision guard.
title: Batch update a Google Sheet
description: Apply a list of Google Sheet API requests to a spreadsheet, all or none.
$idempotencyComment: batchUpdate declares no idempotency key. Whether a retry is safe depends on the requests: a replace is usually a no-op the second time, an insert is not.

config.label: Spreadsheet ID
config.description: The id in the spreadsheet's own URL.

config.label: Requests
config.description: Google's Request objects, in order. Example: [{"findReplace":{"find":"{{name}}","replacement":"Ada","allSheets":true}}].

outputShape.description: One reply per request, in order. Many kinds reply with an empty object.
